calls.title: Demo Set Discussion
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the successful launch of version 4.4 as a significant milestone, with plans for continuous feature rollouts to support marketing and sales. Key discussions included the development of sales enablement materials and the creation of a high-quality, vertical-specific demo environment with realistic data. The team's demo strategy is shifting to emphasize AI-driven experimentation, catering to customer maturity and needs. Improved observability features and insights are being integrated into the platform to enhance demo impact. Collaboration on demo infrastructure and scripting is ongoing, with engineering support essential for data management and automation, ensuring effective demos.
calls.keywords: Demo environment, AI integration, Vertical targeting, Sales demos, Feature flags, Experiment dashboards
calls.action_items:
